summary: First-finish smoke test of DACOT Hub MVP. Backend auth (login/me/logout, wrong-password in pt-BR), dashboard stats/activity, tenants CRUD + filters/search, modules catalog, tenant-modules activate/deactivate/patch/launch_url, delivery 400, and tenant users all pass with expected data (5 tenants, 2 active, 2 trial, 1 suspended, 6 modules, Hamburgueria has 3 users). Frontend E2E flow (login -> dashboard KPIs 2/2/5/5 -> Clientes list w/ 5 rows, filter active=2, search hamburgueria=1 -> detail with tabs Overview/Modules/Users and toggles present -> Modulos catalog 6 cards -> Logout back to login) all pass.
passed: POST /api/auth/login (200, returns user, sets httpOnly cookies)
POST /api/auth/login wrong password -> 401 + 'E-mail ou senha inválidos'
GET /api/hub/dashboard/stats -> counts match (5/2/2/1/0, active_modules=5, 6 per_module entries)
GET /api/hub/tenants/{id}/modules -> 6 entries with can_activate false for in_dev/planned
POST /modules/delivery/activate -> 400 'Módulo não está disponível para ativação'
Frontend login -> dashboard, KPI values (2/2/5/5) render correctly
Sidebar user-name shows 'Davi Braga'; menu-dashboard/clientes/modulos navigate
Tenant detail page shows tab-overview/tab-modules/tab-users; toggle-orders + toggle-customers rendered
notes: Test credentials read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. All calls used REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL public URL. Viewport 1440x900.
